visual_action: A slideshow of simple stick-figure animations on a white background. Each slide depicts a scenario where an ID is needed: a person holding an ID card, driving a car, showing an ID to a pilot before boarding a plane, holding a mug of beer, opening a bank account with a teller, and holding an unemployment form. The final slide shows the stick figure holding an ID next to a ballot box, with a call to action.

cast.name: The White House
cast.evidence: The White House logo appears in the bottom right corner of every frame of the video.

on_screen_text.text: You need an ID for so many things! (except voting in the U.S.)
You need an ID to drive a car
You need an ID to get on a plane
You need an ID to buy a beer
You need an ID to open a bank account
You need an ID to get a job or file for unemployment
So... why not elections? Pass the Save America Act

spoken_summary: There is no spoken dialogue in the video, only a song with lyrics playing throughout.
audio_music: An upbeat, electronic pop song ('The girl, so confusing version with lorde' by Charli xcx and Lorde) plays consistently throughout the video, serving as a modern and engaging backing track for the slideshow.
editing_pacing: The video is a slideshow of static cartoon images, with each image displayed for a few seconds before cutting to the next.
central_claim: An ID should be required for voting in the U.S. because it is required for many other common activities, and Congress should pass the Save America Act to enact this change.
intended_effect: To persuade viewers that voter ID laws are a common-sense measure and to build support for the 'Save America Act'.
